reasons: Both answers cover every rubric item in Russian, giving the 2 million / 3 million limits and noting that the refund depends on НДФЛ paid; B frames «льгота» as the broader term a little more clearly. B, however, gives several wrong practical claims: the remainder carries over only 4 years, the interest deduction is unavailable through the employer, the ДДУ right needs ownership registration, and pre-2014 users can claim the remainder. A's errors are mostly wrong citations and historical details, so its practical guidance is more reliable.

A: Cites пп. 2 and пп. 3 п. 1 ст. 220 for the purchase and interest deductions; the current subparagraphs are пп. 3 and пп. 4
Says that before 2009 the interest limit was 3 million and the purchase deduction had no limit; before 2014 the interest deduction had no limit and the purchase deduction was capped
Cites 212-ФЗ as dated 29.11.2014; the law is dated 23.07.2013
Bases the relatives exclusion on ст. 1055 ГК РФ; it comes from п. 5 ст. 220 НК РФ / ст. 105.1
Says the refund goes to 'ваш счёт в ФНС'; it is paid to the taxpayer's bank account
B: Says the unused remainder carries over only up to 4 years (п. 9 ст. 220); it carries over until used up, and п. 9 is the carry-back for pensioners
Says the interest deduction cannot be received through the employer; it can
Says the ДДУ deduction is available only after ownership registration; the acceptance act is sufficient
Says people who used the deduction before 2009 can claim the remainder on a new purchase; the remainder can be transferred only for rights arising after 2014
